script.opening_words:
Your parents bought their first house
for $85,000 in 1992 or that same house
today, $420,000.
Meanwhile, your salary is maybe twice
what theirs was. The math doesn't work.
You already know this. Uh what you might
not know is that every single piece of
traditional financial advice you've been
handed is built on an economy that no
longer exists. Save 10%, skip the daily
coffee, make a budget. It's all noise.
You cannot budget your way out of a
structural crisis. The game board has
fundamentally ch
script.ending_words:
bility to say no. The discipline to
look stupid for a decade while you build
something real. The courage to drive
past the nice neighborhoods in your paid
off sedan knowing you're stacking cash
while they're stacking payments. That's
your weapon. Use it. If you want the
exact step-by-step breakdown of where
every dollar should go once you stop
hemorrhaging money, I've got a video on
the optimal order for investing. It's
the tactical playbook for what comes
after you've won the mental game. Links
in the description. Watch it next if
you're serious about this. Otherwise,
enjoy the truck payment.
